name: Kawaisou na Mahou
source:
Recently, my younger brother has been dressing up with a lot of enthusiasm. Apparently, he has a new girlfriend....But upon closer inspection, I'd realized that this "girlfriend" is actually a classmate of mine, cross-dressing as a woman!

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/17871]Freem[/url]]
